name: Amarris
tagline: Every slip, mooring, and maintenance log in one calm harbor.
positioning: Amarris is the marina operations tool for independent dock owners and small harbor hosts who still run their bookings on a whiteboard and a shoebox of receipts.

hero.h1: Run your dock like a real harbor, not a group chat.
hero.sub: Amarris keeps your slip assignments, seasonal dues, haul-out schedules, and weather holds in one place — so your boaters know where to tie up and you know who still owes for winter storage.

features.title: Live slip board
features.description: Drag boats onto a visual dock map. See open slips, rafted vessels, and seasonal reservations at a glance instead of squinting at a laminated grid.

features.title: Dues that collect themselves
features.description: Auto-invoice monthly moorage, electric, and pump-out fees. Boaters pay from a link; you stop chasing checks left under the office door.

features.title: Haul-out & maintenance logs
features.description: Track bottom paint, zinc swaps, and engine service per hull. Every boat carries its own history, so nothing gets serviced twice or missed entirely.

features.title: Weather & tide holds
features.description: Get flagged when a small-craft advisory or spring tide hits your harbor, and notify affected slip holders before the wind does the talking.

features.title: Waitlist that ranks itself
features.description: Applicants queue by length, draft, and request date. When a slip frees up, Amarris surfaces the right boat instead of the loudest email.

features.title: Season rollover in minutes
features.description: Roll agreements, rates, and slip assignments into a new season without re-typing a single contract or renegotiating every handshake.

testimonials.quote: I used to keep the whole marina in a spiral notebook and my head. Amarris put the slip map on my phone, and now my dockhands stop calling me at dinner to ask which finger pier is open.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitcomb

testimonials.quote: The dues invoicing paid for itself in one season. We recovered four unpaid winter storage balances I'd honestly written off, and no more awkward conversations at the fuel dock.
testimonials.name: Marcus Reyburn

testimonials.quote: As a guy with six moorings and a good stretch of dock, I didn't want enterprise software. Amarris feels built for someone my size — the maintenance log alone keeps my regulars coming back.
testimonials.name: Priya Ellison

homepage.footerBlurb: Amarris is built for the people who actually walk the docks. Fewer whiteboards, fewer shoeboxes, more time on the water.
